```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tximport)
library(readr)
library(DESeq2)

# Load sample metadata
samples <- read_tsv("samples.txt")

# Set up paths and names
files <- samples$quant
names(files) <- samples$sample_id

# Load transcript-to-gene map from Trinity
#tx2gene <- read_tsv("Trinity.fasta.gene_trans_map", col_names = c("TXNAME", #"GENEID"))

tx2gene <- read.delim("Trinity.fasta.gene_trans_map", header = FALSE)
tx2gene <- tx2gene[, c(2,1)]  # Flip columns: transcript, gene
colnames(tx2gene) <- c("TXNAME", "GENEID")


txi <- tximport(files, type = "salmon", tx2gene = tx2gene)

# Create DESeq2 dataset
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi, colData = samples, design = ~ species)

# Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Results for syriaca vs speciosa
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("species", "syriaca", "speciosa"))

# View summary
summary(res)

# Order by adjusted p-value
resOrdered <- res[order(res$padj), ]

# Write results
write.csv(as.data.frame(resOrdered), file = "DESeq2_results_sy_vs_sp.csv")

```


```{r}
# Load pfam2go, skipping comments
pfam2go_raw <- readLines("pfam2go.txt")
pfam2go_clean <- grep("^Pfam:", pfam2go_raw, value = TRUE)

# Parse Pfam ID and GO ID from each line
pfam_entries <- str_match(pfam2go_clean, "^Pfam:(PF\\d+)\\s+.*>.*GO:.*;\\s*(GO:\\d+)$")

# Remove lines that didn't match
pfam_entries <- pfam_entries[!is.na(pfam_entries[, 2]), ]

# Create mapping table
pfam_map <- data.frame(
  Pfam_ID = pfam_entries[, 2],
  GO_ID   = pfam_entries[, 3],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Check it
head(pfam_map)


```


```{r}

res <- results(dds, contrast = c("species", "syriaca", "speciosa"))
resOrdered <- as.data.frame(res[order(res$padj), ])
resOrdered$gene_id <- rownames(resOrdered)  # Store rownames as a column

head(resOrdered)
```

```{r}
# Get all matches like PF00487.30
annot$Pfam_IDs <- str_extract_all(annot$Pfam, "PF\\d+\\.\\d+")

# Check the result
head(annot$Pfam_IDs, 5)
```
```{r}
annot$Pfam_IDs <- lapply(annot$Pfam_IDs, function(x) gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", x))

# Check again
head(annot$Pfam_IDs, 5)

```


```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

annot_expanded <- annot %>%
  unnest(Pfam_IDs) %>%
  left_join(pfam_map, by = c("Pfam_IDs" = "Pfam_ID")) %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  summarise(GO_terms = paste(unique(GO_ID[!is.na(GO_ID)]), collapse = ";"), .groups = "drop")

```


```{r}
merged_go <- merge(resOrdered, annot_expanded, by = "gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
#table(is.na(merged_go$GO_terms))
write.table(merged_go, "cytoscape_DE_GO.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

```


```{r}
# Keep just the gene and GO term columns
go_pairs <- merged_go %>% 
  filter(!is.na(GO_terms)) %>%
  select(gene_id, GO_terms)

# Expand into one row per gene-GO combination
go_expanded <- go_pairs %>%
  separate_rows(GO_terms, sep = ";")

# Check the result
head(go_expanded)
```

```{r}
go_edges <- inner_join(go_expanded, go_expanded, by = "GO_terms")

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Remove self-loops (gene paired with itself)
go_edges <- go_edges %>% filter(gene_id.x != gene_id.y)

# Ensure each pair is unique (no A–B and B–A duplicates)
go_edges$edge_key <- apply(go_edges[, c("gene_id.x", "gene_id.y")], 1, function(x) paste(sort(x), collapse = "_"))
go_edges <- go_edges[!duplicated(go_edges$edge_key), ]

# Keep final format
go_network_edges <- go_edges[, c("gene_id.x", "gene_id.y", "GO_terms")]
colnames(go_network_edges) <- c("Source", "Target", "GO_term")

# Export to Cytoscape
write.table(go_network_edges, "go_network_edges_fixed.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

```





```{r}
# Start with: genes and GO terms split by semicolon
go_pairs <- merged_go[!is.na(merged_go$GO_terms), c("gene_id", "GO_terms")]

# Expand to one row per GO term
go_expanded <- go_pairs %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(GO_terms, sep = ";")

# Self-join on GO term to get gene pairs
go_edges <- merge(go_expanded, go_expanded, by = "GO_terms")

# Remove self-loops
go_edges <- go_edges[go_edges$gene_id.x != go_edges$gene_id.y, ]

# Ensure undirected uniqueness (A–B = B–A)
go_edges$pair <- apply(go_edges[, c("gene_id.x", "gene_id.y")], 1, function(x) paste(sort(x), collapse = "_"))
go_edges <- go_edges[!duplicated(go_edges$pair), ]

# Keep only source, target, and the shared GO term
go_network_edges <- go_edges[, c("gene_id.x", "gene_id.y", "GO_terms")]
colnames(go_network_edges) <- c("Source", "Target", "GO_term")

# Write for Cytoscape
write.table(go_network_edges, "go_network_edges_fixed.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)


```
